summary.name: Buffer
summary.one_liner: Buffer is a lightweight, privacy-first clipboard manager for macOS with searchable history, image support, and on-device OCR.
use_cases: Recovering a snippet copied earlier in the day
Searching past copied text or images
Extracting text from screenshots or copied images
Keeping sensitive clipboard data off the cloud
Saving frequently reused snippets with bookmarks
summary.what_it_does: Buffer runs in the macOS menu bar and automatically captures text and images as you copy them. Opening it with Shift+Command+V shows the history, where a real-time fuzzy search finds items across the whole history. Images can be inspected in a canvas with pinch-to-zoom and pan, and text can be extracted from them using Apple's on-device Vision framework. Items can be bookmarked, pinned, tagged with color-coded tags, edited inline, and multi-selected for pasting together. The page says all data is stored locally with no accounts or telemetry.
notable: On-device OCR via Apple's Vision framework, fully offline
Bookmarks protect items from automatic history eviction
Configurable history tiers: 200, 1,000, or Unlimited items
Privacy-first: all data stored locally, no accounts or telemetry
caveats: Requires Accessibility permissions on first launch
